task: Probability that a driver finishes on the podium, estimated before the start
unit: one row per driver per Grand Prix start (Indy 500 and non-starters excluded)

features.grid: starting grid slot (pit-lane starts placed at the back)
features.grid_rel: grid slot divided by field size
features.grid_missing: pit-lane start or grid not recorded
features.driver_podium_rate: driver's podium rate over his previous 10 starts
features.driver_finish_rate: driver's classified-finish rate over his previous 10 starts
features.driver_grid_rel_avg: driver's average relative grid slot over his previous 10 starts
features.team_podiums_per_race: team's podiums per race over its previous 10 races
features.team_points_share_season: team's share of all points scored so far this season (before this race)
features.team_points_share_prev_season: team's share of all points in the previous season

leakage_guard: every form feature uses earlier races only (shifted rolling windows); points, laps and finishing status of the race itself are never inputs
selection_rule: lowest validation log loss among the learned models

metrics_explained.log_loss: penalty for confident wrong probabilities (lower is better)
metrics_explained.brier: mean squared error of the probabilities (lower is better)
metrics_explained.roc_auc: chance a random podium finisher gets a higher probability than a random non-podium one
metrics_explained.podium_places_called: share of the three podium places taken by the model's top three picks per race
